1. Convert liter to gallon: liter_to_gallon(liter=150)
2. Round to nearest integer: 40
3. Fill fuel tank: fillFuelTank(fuelAmount=40)
4. Start engine: startEngine(ignitionMode="START")

We might want to do them in order: conversion, rounding, filling, starting.
